relationships.description: GraphRAG is designed to answer queries requiring global sensemaking over the entire data corpus.
GraphRAG applies graph-based community detection to create a thematic partitioning of the data.
GraphRAG leverages the concept of 'self-memory' described in Cheng et al. 2024.
GraphRAG uses summaries to answer queries as in Mao et al. 2020.
